description: Extract of govulncheck's JSON stream before a dependency update of the predecessor repository: config, progress and every finding are kept; the SBOM is dropped, and each OSV entry that a finding names keeps only its id and summary.
go_mod: go 1.25.0 with github.com/moby/go-archive v0.2.0, golang.org/x/crypto v0.54.0, github.com/klauspost/compress v1.18.6
command: GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 GOWORK=off GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly govulncheck -format json -test ./...

historical_origin.availability: unavailable: none of the identities listed in unavailable resolves in this repository (its commits are absent and its run and job URLs return 404). They stay as recorded so that the execution remains distinguishable from an unmodified source run.

evidence_role: historical scanner fixture: govulncheck output retained from the archived predecessor repository. It is not a scan of this repository's current source.
